description.zh:
要操作的域名。

> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name to operate on.

> The domain name must have website business forwarding rules configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh:
要封禁的地域列表。

> 不设置该参数表示关闭区域封禁（针对域名）功能。
description.en:
The list of regions to block.

> Not setting this parameter indicates turning off the location blacklist (for domain names) feature.

description.zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[创建资源组](~~94485~~)。
description.en:
The resource group ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance in the Resource Management service. The default value is empty, which means the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information, see [Create a resource group](~~94485~~).

title.zh: 设置网站业务区域封禁地区

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-area-block --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain www.aliyun.com --regions CN-310000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
